description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by JSON: chose "option-a" for #691 = fix demand analysis first so a closure-called entry publishes its floor at once, then land the widened prune with no pin change).

Bug: DeriveRuntimeDemand publishes a lambda's input demand from its body alone at the first derivation, while its callers' contribution is still unknown and treated as Ignore. A closure callsite always floors every lane to Whole (src/compiler2/jobs/runtime_demand.rs, the closure-callsite floor, ~2600). So the published demand is revised upward at the second derivation (settle_input_demands, runtime_demand.rs:1171), and the revision wakes the callers. "Not yet known" is published as Ignore: unknown is not none.

Evidence (JSON's fz-nml.9.4 builder): the widened unread-binding prune (case, cond, with, rescue arms) on `for {_id, %{name: "fz.compiler2.job"} = s} <- spans, do: s` in tools/distill-telemetry.exs (fns 239, 274): the lambda first publishes TupleFields[Ignore, Whole], then revises to TupleFields[Whole, Whole], the same final answer as before. Cost: 6 extra DeriveRuntimeDemand runs (main, timeline, Enum.reduce's lambda), distiller pin +76 derivations / +2671 reads; key set unchanged.

Fix direction: a closure-called entry's first publish includes the floor its call shape guarantees.

Acceptance: on develop alone no pin rises, falls are lowered; with the widened prune on top (patch: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/ebbfffd8-2561-4da7-bcda-f9a316d00a1e/scratchpad/nml9-4/widened.patch) the distiller's (derivations, reads) are no higher than develop's.

Blocks: fz-nml.9.4's widening on #691.
Overlap: MDF's fz-sc8.230 WIP (../fz-sc8-fold, 2468a8db1, uncommitted to a PR) edits runtime_demand.rs inline_dispatch_input_demands (~2206-2250): an arm no longer takes parameters as whole values. Different function, same file and the same demand question for case arms.
title: A closure-called entry's input demand starts at its floor
